strategy_roster.name: RCI
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,10)) / (donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10)), sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,10)) / (donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10)),14))
strategy_roster.exit_long: crossbelow(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,10)) / (donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10)), sma(100 * (close - donchian_low(low,10)) / (donchian_high(high,10) - donchian_low(low,10)),14))
strategy_roster.notes: The Rank Correlation Index has no DSL function, so it is approximated by the bounded 10-bar range position (RciLength 10) crossed against the documented SMA(14) of itself, which preserves the rising-above-average long rule and the opposite-cross exit. The Direction restriction, the no-stop configuration and the 1-minute CandleType are not signals.

strategy_roster.name: Triple Moving Average Crossover
strategy_roster.entry_long: crossabove(sma(close,10), sma(close,20)) and sma(close,10) > sma(close,50) and sma(close,20) > sma(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: FastMaLength, MediumMaLength and SlowMaLength carry no values so 10/20/50 SMAs are explicit fallbacks, and the entry implements the branch used when EnableEntryMediumSlowCross is false: a fast-over-medium cross with both averages on the same side of the slow one. The documented fast/slow opposite cross is the exit, the medium/slow entry branch is unused for the long side, and StartProtection has no distances.

strategy_roster.name: CCFp Currencies Strength
strategy_roster.notes: Signals require a spread between the relative strength scores of two different currencies built from seven USD-based FX pairs, which a single-instrument OHLCV engine cannot compute, so the never-true guard records the limitation instead of inventing one. Fast/Slow MA, Strength Step, Close Opposite and base Volume are cross-market parameters.

strategy_roster.name: ADX Range Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Documented defaults are used verbatim: a close at or above the previous 34-bar highest close while ADX(14) stays under the 17.5 quiet-market threshold. The 1000-unit stop, the session restriction, MaxTradesPerDay 3 and the 30-minute CandleType are price-unit and schedule features, so the mirrored range break exits and the percentage fields stay null.

strategy_roster.name: Dual Supertrend MACD
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > ema(close,10) + 3 * atr(high,low,close,10) and close > ema(close,20) + 5 * atr(high,low,close,20) and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < ema(close,10) + 3 * atr(high,low,close,10) or close < ema(close,20) + 5 * atr(high,low,close,20) or macd(close,12,26) < macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: Both SuperTrend lines are rebuilt from the documented parameters as their EMA basis plus the factor times ATR: ema(close,10)+3.0*atr(10) and ema(close,20)+5.0*atr(20), and a positive MACD histogram is macd(12,26) above its 9 signal, exactly as documented. Either line flipping or the histogram crossing zero exits; there are no stops by default and the TradeDirection switch is not a long-roster input.

strategy_roster.name: Virtual Trailing Stop
strategy_roster.notes: The docs state the strategy does not generate entry signals and expects orders to be opened externally, so it is a pure position-management utility and the never-true guard is used. StopLoss, TakeProfit, TrailingStop, TrailingStart and TrailingStep are all price-step offsets that a signal-based roster cannot hold.

strategy_roster.name: Open Time Daily Window
strategy_roster.notes: Orders are placed inside a daily time window (Trading Time 18:50, 5 minutes) and flattened in the Close Position Time 20:50 window, with long entries disabled by default via Allow Buy Entries false, so there is no market-derived signal and the never-true guard is used. Stop-Loss/Take-Profit points and the trailing switch are price-distance settings.

strategy_roster.name: Ticker Pulse Meter + Fear EKG
strategy_roster.notes: The combined percentile is approximated by the 50-bar range position (LookbackShort 50, with the 200-bar lookback dropped) and the documented thresholds are applied to it: recovering above EntryThresholdHigh 20 is the long entry and rolling back under the OrangeEntryThreshold/ProfitTake 95 level is the profit-take exit. EntryThresholdLow 40 and the Fear EKG visualisation are not used, and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Turbo Scaler Grid
strategy_roster.notes: Entries are pending stop grids at operator-configured base prices with PendingStepPoints spacing, activated by Level1 proximity or multi-timeframe confirmations, so no market-derived directional signal exists and the never-true guard is used. Break-even/trailing points, PendingQuantity and the daily block levels are order-management settings.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Multic
strategy_roster.notes: The doc lists Indicators: None: positions open in an internal predefined direction when balance exceeds Margin, volume escalates after wins and direction flips after losses, with Loss/Profit/KChange/KClose thresholds in account currency across several FX pairs. That is a money-management martingale rather than a market signal, so the never-true guard is used.
